content_sections.heading: GTBH Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the GTBH Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download GTBH Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: GTBH Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 58 vacancies are available - 10 for Medicine, 3 for Endocrinology, 8 for Radiology, 3 for General Surgery, 4 for Burns & Plastic, 6 for Neurosurgery, 2 for Pathology, 8 for Anaesthesia, 1 for Pediatrics, 1 for Hematology Pediatrics (Oncology), 1 for Orthopaedics, 1 for Obst. & Gynae, 1 for Forensic Medicine, 1 for Ophthalmology, 1 for ENT, 1 for DEM (Diabetics, Endocrinology and Metabolism) Surgery, 1 for Biochemistry, 1 for DEM Biochemistry, 1 for Dermatology, and 3 for A&E.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: MEDICINE, ENDOCRINOLOGY, RADIOLOGY, GENERAL SURGERY, BURNS & PLASTIC, NEUROSURGERY, PATHOLOGY, ANAESTHESIA, PEDIATRICS, HEMATOLOGY PEDIATRICS (ONCOLOGY), ORTHOPAEDICS, OBST. & GYNAE, FORENSIC MEDICINE, OPHTHALMOLOGY, ENT, DEM (DIABETICS, ENDOCRINOLOGY AND METABOLISM) SURGERY, BIOCHEMISTRY, DEM BIOCHEMISTRY, DERMATOLOGY, A&E: Post Graduate Degree/ DNB/ PG Diploma or MBBS with 3 years experience in relevant field.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years. Age relaxation: 05 years for SC/ ST, 03 years for OBC. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Rs. 67,700/ - + NPA in pay level 11 per month.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the GTBH Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of GTBH to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Senior Resident Doctors post at GTBH?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Senior Resident Doctors post at Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital (GTBH) is 17th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted online before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Senior Resident Doctors at GTBH?
faq.answer: There are a total of 58 vacancies for the Senior Resident Doctors post at Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital (GTBH) as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident Doctors post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree/DNB/PG Diploma or MBBS with 3 years of experience in the relevant field to be eligible for the Senior Resident Doctors position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applying to the Senior Resident Doctors post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Senior Resident Doctors post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the GTBH Senior Resident Doctors recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC candidates is Rs. 500/-. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident Doctors position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Resident Doctors post will receive a salary of Rs. 67,700/- per month, plus NPA in pay level 11.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the GTBH Senior Resident Doctors recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident Doctors post at GTBH will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode can candidates apply for the GTBH Senior Resident Doctors positions?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for the GTBH Senior Resident Doctors positions through the Online mode only. The application link will be available on the official website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital (GTBH)?
faq.answer: Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital (GTBH) is located in Delhi, with the pincode 110095.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or ad-hoc job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for Senior Resident Doctors at Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital (GTBH) is on an Ad-hoc basis.
